# Vexo v1.0.0 — Initial Release

The first public release of **Vexo**, a Fabric client-side mod for Hypixel SkyBlock focused on Dungeons, Kuudra, and quality-of-life improvements.

## ✨ Features

**Dungeons**

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Healer P5 Leap Alert | HUD message when all players have leaped to P5 in M7 — customizable text |
| Rag Axe Alert | HUD title telling you when it's time to use the Rag Axe |
| Pad Timer | Calculates when to crush Storm based on your chosen crush order |
| Particle Hider | Hides distracting particles during runs |
| Party Finder | Extra player info in the Party Finder UI (secrets, Fairy Perk, etc.) |
| Positional Messages | Auto-sends party messages when standing on specific M7 positions |
| Auto Dungeon Requeue | Starts a new run of the current floor after a configurable delay |
| Storm Pillar Timer | Confirms when Storm has been crushed |
| Necron Block Highlight | Highlights the exact blocks to mine |

**Kuudra**

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Auto Kuudra Requeue | Starts a new instance after each run, configurable delay |
| Solo Detector | Alerts your party via `/pc` when all teammates are eliminated |
| Chest Tracker | Tracks your chest count toward the 60-chest limit |
| Profit Tracker | Values Croesus chest loot, subtracts cost, highlights the best chest |
| Backbone Alert | HUD bar timing the Bonemerang backbone, tells you when to Rend |
| Eaten Timer | Countdown when you get eaten by Kuudra |
| Fire Veil Overlay | Shows the Fire Veil radius and marks the wand in the hotbar |
| Kuudra Party Finder Info | Kuudra stats for players joining via Party Finder |
| Recolor Lava | Renders lava as water (or a custom color) for better visibility |

**Quality of Life**

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Slayer Helper | Remaining Slayer bosses and estimated time to next level |
| Chat Cleaner | Filters repetitive/spammy chat messages |
| Auto Rejoin | Automatically rejoins SkyBlock after being kicked |
| Screenshot Actions | Crop/edit actions on screenshot notifications, auto-copy to clipboard |
| Wardrobe | Quick armor set switching via keybinds |
| Loadouts | Quick loadout switching in the new Loadouts GUI via keybinds |

**Commands**

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/vexo` | Opens the mod configuration menu |
| `/tyfr` | Leaves the party after the current run ends |
| `/reinvite` | Leaves the party, then messages the lead "!inv" |
| `/kuudrastats [player]` | Shows Kuudra stats for yourself or the given player |
| `/rewarp <warp>` | Warps to your island, then to the given warp |
| `/dn` | Warps to the Dungeon Hub |
| `/entrance` | Queues for the Dungeon Entrance |
| `/f1`–`/f7` | Queues for Floor 1–7 |
| `/m1`–`/m7` | Queues for Master Mode Floor 1–7 |
| `/t1`–`/t5` | Queues for Kuudra Tiers 1–5 |

## 📦 Requirements

| Dependency | Link |
|---|---|
| Minecraft 26.1.x + Fabric Loader | [fabricmc.net](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) |
| Fabric API | [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) |
| Fabric Language Kotlin | [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) |

## 📥 Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 26.1.x
2. Install the two dependencies above into `.minecraft/mods`
3. Drop the Vexo `.jar` into `.minecraft/mods`
4. Launch with the Fabric profile

## ⚙️ Configuration

Open the in-game config with `/vexo` or via ModMenu. Every feature can be toggled and configured individually; HUD elements are repositionable via **Move HUD**.

---

This is the first release — expect bugs and rough edges. Found one, or have a feature request? Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/wfW3aEEpVA).
